policies.title: Terms of Service
policies.description: Required to create and use an ATLAS account.

policies.title: Privacy Policy
policies.description: Required for lawful processing of your profile and account data.

policies.title: Platform Data Processing
policies.description: Allows ATLAS to store and process profile data needed for platform operation.

policies.title: Profile Storage
policies.description: Allows ATLAS to save your professional profile and onboarding progress.

policies.title: Uploaded Document Processing
policies.description: Allows technical validation, private storage, preview and extraction of uploaded documents.

policies.title: AI CV Analysis
policies.description: Allows structured analysis of your CV. Without it ATLAS uses only manual data and technical extraction.

policies.title: AI Matching
policies.description: Allows your profile to be used for automated job matching.

policies.title: Share Profile With Employer
policies.description: Allows sharing your profile with a specific employer after a separate decision.

policies.title: Marketing Messages
policies.description: Allows ATLAS to send non-essential product and partner messages.

policies.title: Personalized Recommendations
policies.description: Allows ATLAS to personalize recommendations beyond the core onboarding result.

policies.title: Anonymous Service Improvement
policies.description: Allows use of anonymized data to improve ATLAS services.
